diagnostics.message: When the scale-down Lambda is configured with VPC networking, it should wait for the VPC execution-role policy attachment so Lambda has the required ENI permissions during function setup; the function currently depends on the role but not this attachment.

If scale-up Lambda is configured for VPC access, it should wait for the VPC execution-role policy attachment to be applied before creation; otherwise Lambda may lack the ENI permissions required for VPC setup. This function currently depends on its role but not the attachment.

If the SSM housekeeper Lambda is configured for VPC access, it should wait for the VPC execution-role policy attachment to be applied before creation; otherwise Lambda may lack the ENI permissions required for VPC setup. This function currently depends on its role but not the attachment.

If the pool Lambda is configured for VPC access, it should wait for the VPC execution-role policy attachment to be applied before creation; otherwise Lambda may lack the ENI permissions required for VPC setup. This function currently depends on its role but not the attachment.

If the job-retry Lambda is configured for VPC access, it should wait for the VPC execution-role policy attachment to be applied before creation; otherwise Lambda may lack the ENI permissions required for VPC setup. This function currently depends on its role but not the attachment.

The EventBridge target can be registered before the Lambda resource-based permission exists, leaving scheduled invocations unauthorized until the permission is applied. Make the target wait for the corresponding Lambda permission.

The EventBridge target can be registered before the Lambda resource-based permission exists, leaving scheduled invocations unauthorized until the permission is applied. Make the target wait for the corresponding Lambda permission.
The SQS event source mapping may become active before the scale-up Lambda execution role has the queue permissions supplied by this inline policy. It should wait for the policy before polling begins.

The SQS event source mapping may become active before the job-retry Lambda execution role has the required queue permissions supplied by this inline policy. It should wait for the policy before polling begins.
The schedule can start invoking the Lambda before its scheduler execution role has the invoke permission granted by this policy. Make schedule creation wait for the role policy.
